newsitem.title: FRANCE: French wheat recovers losses after EU tender.
newsitem.headline: French wheat recovers losses after EU tender.

text.p: French wheat, which had weakened slightly ahead of Thursday's European Union tender, recovered the lost ground of five francs afterwards, grain traders said.
Prices for Rouen delivery reached 890 francs per tonne for March and 885 francs for April excluding carrying charges.
Traders cited a wheat export volume of 436,000 tonnes that appeared to deflate a market squeeze over export licences.
Carrying charges for March are 54.53 francs for the first half and 58.17 francs for the second half.
For April they are 61.81 francs for the first half and 65.44 for the second half.
